ship_audit.gate: The Apply button IS the gate — the proposal must reach the user unapplied.
ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — a proposal identical to the current text should be refused or reported as a no-op, not shown as an edit.
ship_audit.tenancy: n/a by construction — it edits the chapter open in the caller's own editor.

PROPOSE_EDIT_OPERATIONS = ['insert_at_cursor', 'replace_selection'] - both defined by where the caret is and what the author has selected. chat-service's EditorContext is book_id, chapter_id and an optional chapter_title: no selection, no range, no cursor, no flag saying whether anything is selected. So 'make the opening line darker' cannot be turned into replace_selection without GUESSING that the author has that line highlighted.

The model reads the chapter, finds the real opening line, and offers three rewrites. That is a defensible answer to a request whose affordance it cannot confirm applies.
